style: Style: clean modern Japanese manga / anime style, soft cel shading, bright friendly palette, rounded shapes, no harsh shadows, warm daylight, contemporary Japan, kid-safe e-learning illustration.

scenes.title: 社長室
scenes.scene: Scene: the corner office of a small IT company on a high floor, EMPTY of people. On the left, a low wooden bookshelf with books and a few green potted plants, and a clean desk with a slim monitor and a keyboard. In the middle and on the right, a wide floor-to-ceiling window with a bright modern city skyline under a blue sky with soft white clouds. A small round meeting table with two light chairs stands in the middle left. The right third of the picture is calm and uncluttered (just window and sky) so that a standing person can be placed there later. Warm morning daylight, soft shadows, welcoming and tidy.
